pages.body:
Why This Book Exists


Have you ever celebrated a holiday and not known why? You eat the food. You sing the songs. You spend time with family. But you have no idea where the traditions came from. You just do them because you always have.


That is how many people feel about the Passover. They read about it in the Bible. They see it in movies. They hear about it in church. But they do not understand it. They do not know why it matters. They do not know why God told the Israelites to celebrate it forever. They do not know why it is still important today.


I get it. I have been there. I have read about the lamb and the blood and the doorposts. I have wondered why God would ask His people to paint blood on their houses. I have wondered what it all meant. But here is the thing. The Passover is not just an ancient ritual. It is a picture. It is a preview. It is a prophecy. It is a shadow. And every detail points to Jesus.


This book is for you. You are new to the faith. You are trying to understand. You are trying to build a foundation. Over the next 30 days, we are going to look at 30 details of the Passover. We are going to see what they meant. We are going to see why they were given. And we are going to see how Jesus fulfilled every single one of them. We are going to see the real meaning of the Passover.


The Value You Will Get


By the end of this book, you will not be confused by the Passover. You will understand it. You will understand its purpose. You will understand its symbolism. And you will understand its fulfillment. You will see that the Passover was never meant to be an empty ritual. It was meant to be a picture of Jesus. You will have a new confidence in your faith. You will have a new love for your Bible. pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male a year old. You may take it from the sheep or from the goats." - Exodus 12:5 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Passover lamb had to be perfect. It could not have any spots. It could not have any broken bones. It could not have any sickness. It had to be the best of the flock. This was a rule. It was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, 'Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!'" - John 1:29


Jesus is the Lamb of God. He is without blemish. He is without spot. He is without sin. He is perfect. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony. He is the perfect Lamb.


Why It Matters For You
You are new to the faith. You are learning about sacrifice. You are learning about atonement. The lamb without blemish tells a story of perfection. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have a perfect Lamb. You have a perfect sacrifice. You have a perfect Savior.


Faith Builder
Do you believe that Jesus is perfect? Write down one thing that makes Him the perfect Lamb.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the perfect Lamb. Thank you for being without blemish. Thank you for being without spot. Thank you for being without sin. Thank you for being the perfect sacrifice. Help me to trust in your perfection. Amen.
pages.title: Day 1: The Lamb Without Blemish

pages.subtitle: Free Sample Day (2 of 3)
pages.footer: Day 2 of 30 (Free Preview - Days 1 to 3 are Free)
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"Then they are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the lambs." - Exodus 12:7 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The blood of the lamb had to be applied. It had to be painted on the doorposts. It had to be on the sides. It had to be on the top. It had to be visible. This was a sign. It was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life handed down to you from your ancestors, but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect." - 1 Peter 1:18-19


Jesus is the blood. He shed His blood on the cross. His blood was applied to our hearts. His blood was painted on the doorposts of our lives. His blood is the sign. His blood is the symbol. His blood is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need the blood applied. You need the blood on your doorposts. You need the blood on your heart. The blood on the doorposts tells a story of protection. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you are covered. You are protected. You are saved.


Faith Builder
Do you have the blood applied to your life? Write down one thing you need protection from today.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for shedding your blood for me. Thank you for applying your blood to my heart. Thank you for being my protection. Thank you for being my sign. Help me to trust in your blood. Amen.
pages.title: Day 2: The Blood on the Doorposts

pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"Do not eat the meat raw or boiled in water, but roast it over a fire—with the head, legs and internal organs." - Exodus 12:9 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The lamb had to be roasted. It could not be eaten raw. It could not be boiled. It had to be roasted over a fire. It had to be cooked completely. This was a rule. It was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"Then Jesus said to them, 'The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men. They will kill him, and after three days he will rise.'" - Mark 9:31


Jesus was roasted. He was roasted in the fire of the cross. He was roasted in the fire of suffering. He was roasted in the fire of judgment. He took the fire for us. He took the heat for us. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You deserve the fire. You deserve the judgment. You deserve the heat. But Jesus took it for you. The roasted lamb tells a story of substitution. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you are spared. You are saved. You are forgiven.


Faith Builder
Do you believe that Jesus took the fire for you? Write down one thing you are thankful for about His sacrifice.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the roasted lamb. Thank you for taking the fire for me. Thank you for taking the heat for me. Thank you for taking the judgment for me. Help me to trust in your sacrifice. Amen.
pages.title: Day 3: The Roasted Lamb

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"Eat the meat roasted over the fire, along with bitter herbs, and bread made without yeast." - Exodus 12:8 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The bread had to be unleavened. It had to be made without yeast. It had to be flat. It had to be hard. It had to be quick. This was a rule. It was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"Therefore let us keep the Festival, not with the old bread leavened with malice and wickedness, but with the bread of sincerity and truth." - 1 Corinthians 5:8


Jesus is the unleavened bread. He is the Bread of Life. He is without yeast. He is without sin. He is pure. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony. He is the true bread.


Why It Matters For You
You need the true bread. You need the Bread of Life. You need the unleavened bread. The unleavened bread tells a story of purity. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have the true bread. You have the bread that satisfies.


Faith Builder
Do you have the Bread of Life in your life? Write down one way you can feed on Jesus this week.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the unleavened bread. Thank you for being the Bread of Life. Thank you for being pure. Thank you for being without sin. Help me to feed on you. Help me to be satisfied in you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 4: The Unleavened Bread

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"Eat the meat roasted over the fire, along with bitter herbs, and bread made without yeast." - Exodus 12:8 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The bitter herbs were a part of the Passover meal. They were a reminder. They were a reminder of the bitterness of slavery. They were a reminder of the pain of Egypt. They were a symbol. They pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"But he was pierced for our transgressions, he was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was on him, and by his wounds we are healed." - Isaiah 53:5


Jesus is the bitter herbs. He was pierced. He was crushed. He was punished. He was wounded. He took the bitterness. He took the pain. He took the suffering. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You have experienced bitterness. You have experienced pain. You have experienced suffering. The bitter herbs tell a story of grace. They tell a story of healing. Through Jesus, you are healed. You are restored. You are made whole.


Faith Builder
What bitterness do you need Jesus to heal? Write it down. Give it to Him.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the bitter herbs. Thank you for being pierced. Thank you for being crushed. Thank you for being punished. Thank you for being wounded. Thank you for taking the bitterness. Help me to receive your healing. Amen.
pages.title: Day 5: The Bitter Herbs

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"This is how you are to eat it: with your cloak tucked into your belt, your sandals on your feet and your staff in your hand. Eat it in haste; it is the LORD's Passover." - Exodus 12:11 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Israelites were told to eat the Passover with their shoes on. They were told to be ready to go. They were told to be ready to move. They were told to be ready to leave. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!" - 2 Corinthians 5:17


Jesus is the new exodus. He is the new journey. He is the new beginning. He calls us to leave our old life behind. He calls us to put on our shoes. He calls us to follow Him. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You are on a journey. You are leaving the old life behind. You are walking into the new life. The shoes on your feet tell a story of movement. They tell a story of grace. Through Jesus, you are moving forward. You are walking into your new life.


Faith Builder
What is one thing from your old life you need to leave behind? Write it down. Give it to Jesus.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the new exodus. Thank you for calling me to leave my old life behind. Thank you for calling me to follow you. Help me to put on my shoes. Help me to be ready to move. Help me to walk into my new life. Amen.
pages.title: Day 6: The Shoes on Your Feet

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"This is how you are to eat it: with your cloak tucked into your belt, your sandals on your feet and your staff in your hand. Eat it in haste; it is the LORD's Passover." - Exodus 12:11 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The staff was a symbol of authority. It was a symbol of guidance. It was a symbol of protection. The Israelites were told to hold their staff. They were told to be ready for the journey. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep." - John 10:11


Jesus is the Good Shepherd. He is the staff. He is the authority. He is the guidance. He is the protection. He leads us. He guides us. He protects us. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need guidance. You need protection. You need a shepherd. The staff in your hand tells a story of guidance. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have a shepherd. You have guidance. You have protection.


Faith Builder
Do you need guidance today? Write down one area of your life where you need the Good Shepherd to lead you.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the Good Shepherd. Thank you for being the staff. Thank you for leading me. Thank you for guiding me. Thank you for protecting me. Help me to follow you. Help me to trust you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 7: The Staff in Your Hand

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"This is how you are to eat it: with your cloak tucked into your belt, your sandals on your feet and your staff in your hand. Eat it in haste; it is the LORD's Passover." - Exodus 12:11 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The cloak was a symbol of readiness. It was a symbol of preparation. It was a symbol of urgency. The Israelites were told to tuck their cloak into their belt. They were told to be ready to move. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him." - Matthew 24:44


Jesus is the coming King. He is the one who will return. He calls us to be ready. He calls us to be prepared. He calls us to be watching. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony. He is the reason for our readiness.


Why It Matters For You
You need to be ready. You need to be prepared. You need to be watching. The cloak tucked in tells a story of readiness. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you are ready. You are prepared. You are watching.


Faith Builder
Are you ready for the return of Jesus? Write down one thing you can do to be more ready.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the coming King. Thank you for calling me to be ready. Help me to be prepared. Help me to be watching. Help me to be ready for your return. Amen.
pages.title: Day 8: The Cloak Tucked In

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"Eat it in haste; it is the LORD's Passover." - Exodus 12:11 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The meal was to be eaten in haste. It was to be eaten quickly. It was to be eaten with urgency. The Israelites were about to leave Egypt. They had to be ready. They had to be quick. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"As God's co-workers we urge you not to receive God's grace in vain. For he says, 'In the time of my favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you.' I tell you, now is the time of God's favor, now is the day of salvation." - 2 Corinthians 6:1-2


Jesus is the urgency. He is the now. He is the day of salvation. He calls us to respond now. He calls us to move now. He calls us to trust now. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need to respond now. You need to move now. You need to trust now. The haste of the meal tells a story of urgency. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have today. You have now. You have this moment.


Faith Builder
What do you need to do today to respond to Jesus? Write it down. Do it.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the day of salvation. Thank you for the urgency. Help me to respond now. Help me to move now. Help me to trust now. Help me to not delay. Amen.
pages.title: Day 9: The Haste of the Meal

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"It is a night of watching for the LORD, to bring them out of Egypt. So this night is a night of watching for the LORD, for all the Israelites to observe for the generations to come." - Exodus 12:42 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The night of the Passover was a night of watching. It was a night of waiting. It was a night of anticipation. The Israelites were watching for the Lord. They were waiting for deliverance. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"So be on your guard! Remember that for three years I never stopped warning each of you night and day with tears." - Acts 20:31


Jesus is the one we watch for. He is the one we wait for. He is the one we anticipate. He calls us to be on our guard. He calls us to be watching. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need to be watching. You need to be waiting. You need to be anticipating. The night of watching tells a story of anticipation. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have something to watch for. You have someone to wait for.


Faith Builder
What are you watching for today? Write down one thing you are anticipating from God.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the one we watch for. Thank you for being the one we wait for. Help me to be on my guard. Help me to be watching. Help me to be ready for your return. Amen.
pages.title: Day 10: The Night of Watching

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"This is a day you are to commemorate; for the generations to come you shall celebrate it as a festival to the LORD—a lasting ordinance." - Exodus 12:14 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Passover was a memorial. It was a remembrance. It was a reminder. It was a reminder of what God had done. It was a reminder of deliverance. It was a reminder of grace. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"And when he had given thanks, he broke it and said, 'This is my body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of me.'" - 1 Corinthians 11:24


Jesus is the memorial. He is the remembrance. He is the reminder. He gave us communion. He gave us the bread and the cup. He said, "Do this in remembrance of me." He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need to remember. You need to remember what Jesus did. You need to remember His sacrifice. The memorial tells a story of remembrance. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have a memorial. You have a remembrance.


Faith Builder
What do you need to remember about Jesus today? Write it down.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the memorial. Thank you for giving us communion. Thank you for the bread and the cup. Help me to remember your sacrifice. Help me to remember your love. Help me to remember you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 11: The Memorial

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"Celebrate this day as a lasting ordinance for the generations to come." - Exodus 12:17 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Passover was for the generations. It was for the children. It was for the grandchildren. It was for the great-grandchildren. It was a story to be told. It was a story to be passed down. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"We will not hide them from their descendants; we will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of the LORD, his power, and the wonders he has done." - Psalm 78:4


Jesus is the story. He is the story we tell. He is the story we pass down. He is the story of the generations. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You have a story to tell. You have a story to share. You have a story to pass down. The generations tell a story of legacy. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have a story. You have a legacy.


Faith Builder
Who can you tell about Jesus this week? Write down one person you can share your story with.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the story. Thank you for being the story we tell. Help me to tell the next generation about you. Help me to share your love. Help me to pass down your story. Amen.
pages.title: Day 12: The Generations

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"For seven days you are to eat bread made without yeast. On the first day remove the yeast from your houses, for whoever eats anything with yeast in it from the first day through the seventh must be cut off from Israel." - Exodus 12:15 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The leaven had to be removed. It had to be taken out. It had to be gone. The Israelites were told to search their houses. They were told to remove every crumb. They were told to remove every trace. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"Therefore let us keep the Festival, not with the old bread leavened with malice and wickedness, but with the bread of sincerity and truth." - 1 Corinthians 5:8


Jesus is the removal of leaven. He is the one who cleanses. He is the one who purifies. He is the one who removes the sin. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need to remove the leaven. You need to remove the sin. You need to remove the things that separate you from God. The leaven removed tells a story of purity. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you can be pure. You can be clean.


Faith Builder
What leaven do you need to remove from your life today? Write it down. Ask God to help you remove it.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the removal of leaven. Thank you for cleansing me. Thank you for purifying me. Help me to remove the sin from my life. Help me to remove the things that separate me from you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 13: The Leaven Removed

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"On the first day hold a sacred assembly, and another one on the seventh day. Do no work at all on these days, except to prepare food for everyone to eat; that is all you may do." - Exodus 12:16 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The first day and the seventh day were special. They were sacred assemblies. They were days of rest. They were days of worship. They were days of gathering. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"There remains, then, a Sabbath-rest for the people of God; for anyone who enters God's rest also rests from their works, just as God did from his." - Hebrews 4:9-10


Jesus is the first day. He is the seventh day. He is the rest. He is the worship. He is the gathering. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need rest. You need worship. You need gathering. The first and seventh day tells a story of rest. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have rest. You have worship. You have gathering.


Faith Builder
Do you need rest today? Write down one way you can rest in Jesus this week.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the first day. Thank you for being the seventh day. Thank you for being my rest. Thank you for being my worship. Help me to rest in you. Help me to worship you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 14: The First and Seventh Day

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"If any household is too small for a whole lamb, they must share one with their neighbors who live nearby, having regard for the number of people." - Exodus 12:4 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The lamb was for the household. It was for the family. It was for the neighbors. It was for the community. It was to be shared. It was to be eaten together. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching and to fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer." - Acts 2:42


Jesus is the lamb for the household. He is the lamb for the family. He is the lamb for the community. He is the lamb we share. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need community. You need fellowship. You need the family of God. The lamb for the household tells a story of community. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have a family. You have a community.


Faith Builder
Who is your community? Write down one person you can share a meal with this week.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the lamb for the household. Thank you for being the lamb for the family. Thank you for the community. Help me to share you with others. Help me to be part of your family. Amen.
pages.title: Day 15: The Lamb for the Household

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"Then they are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the lambs." - Exodus 12:7 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The blood was on the doorframe. It was on the sides. It was on the top. It was a sign. It was a protection. It was a covering. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God's grace." - Ephesians 1:7


Jesus is the blood on the doorframe. He is the sign. He is the protection. He is the covering. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need protection. You need covering. You need redemption. The blood on the doorframe tells a story of protection. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you are protected. You are covered. You are redeemed.


Faith Builder
Do you need protection today? Write down one thing you need Jesus to cover.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the blood on the doorframe. Thank you for being the sign. Thank you for being the protection. Thank you for being the covering. Thank you for redeeming me. Help me to trust in your blood. Amen.
pages.title: Day 16: The Blood on the Doorframe

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"It is the LORD's Passover." - Exodus 12:11 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Passover was the Lord's. It was His. It was His celebration. It was His memorial. It was His story. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed." - 1 Corinthians 5:7


Jesus is the Lord's Passover. He is the celebration. He is the memorial. He is the story. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need to celebrate. You need to remember. You need to tell the story. The Lord's Passover tells a story of celebration. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have something to celebrate. You have something to remember.


Faith Builder
What are you celebrating today? Write down one thing you are thankful for.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the Lord's Passover. Thank you for being the celebration. Thank you for being the memorial. Thank you for being the story. Help me to celebrate you. Help me to remember you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 17: The Lord's Passover

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"When the LORD goes through the land to strike down the Egyptians, he will see the blood on the top and sides of the doorframe and will pass over that doorway, and he will not permit the destroyer to enter your houses and strike you down." - Exodus 12:23 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The destroyer was coming. The destroyer was passing through. The destroyer was bringing judgment. But the blood was a sign. The blood was a protection. The blood stopped the destroyer. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"And having disarmed the powers and authorities, he made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross." - Colossians 2:15


Jesus is the one who stops the destroyer. He is the one who disarms the powers. He is the one who triumphs over the authorities. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need protection from the destroyer. You need protection from the enemy. You need protection from the powers of darkness. The destroyer tells a story of protection. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you are protected. You are safe.


Faith Builder
Do you need protection from the enemy today? Write down one thing you need Jesus to protect you from.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for stopping the destroyer. Thank you for disarming the powers. Thank you for triumphing over the authorities. Thank you for protecting me. Help me to trust in your protection. Amen.
pages.title: Day 18: The Destroyer

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"On that same night I will pass through Egypt and strike down every firstborn of both people and animals, and I will bring judgment on all the gods of Egypt. I am the LORD." - Exodus 12:12 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The plague was judgment. It was judgment on Egypt. It was judgment on the gods of Egypt. It was judgment on the firstborn. But the blood was a sign. The blood was a protection. The blood stopped the judgment. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"Since we have now been justified by his blood, how much more shall we be saved from God's wrath through him!" - Romans 5:9


Jesus is the one who saves us from the wrath. He is the one who justifies us by His blood. He is the one who saves us from judgment. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You deserve judgment. You deserve wrath. You deserve the plague. But Jesus took it for you. The plague tells a story of substitution. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you are saved. You are justified. You are forgiven.


Faith Builder
Do you believe that Jesus saved you from judgment? Write down one thing you are thankful for about His sacrifice.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for saving me from the wrath. Thank you for justifying me by your blood. Thank you for taking the judgment for me. Thank you for the grace. Help me to trust in your sacrifice. Amen.
pages.title: Day 19: The Plague

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"This is a day you are to commemorate; for the generations to come you shall celebrate it as a festival to the LORD—a lasting ordinance." - Exodus 12:14 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Passover was a feast. It was a celebration. It was a festival. It was a time of joy. It was a time of gratitude. It was a time of remembrance. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"Then I heard what sounded like a great multitude, like the roar of rushing waters and like loud peals of thunder, shouting: 'Hallelujah! For our Lord God Almighty reigns. Let us rejoice and be glad and give him glory! For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready.'" - Revelation 19:6-7


Jesus is the feast. He is the celebration. He is the festival. He is the wedding of the Lamb. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You have something to celebrate. You have something to feast on. You have something to be joyful about. The feast tells a story of celebration. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have joy. You have celebration.


Faith Builder
What are you celebrating today? Write down one thing you are joyful about.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the feast. Thank you for being the celebration. Thank you for being the festival. Thank you for being the wedding of the Lamb. Help me to celebrate you. Help me to rejoice in you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 20: The Feast

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"This is a day you are to commemorate; for the generations to come you shall celebrate it as a festival to the LORD—a lasting ordinance." - Exodus 12:14 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Passover was a memorial. It was a remembrance. It was a reminder. It was a reminder of what God had done. It was a reminder of deliverance. It was a reminder of grace. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"And when he had given thanks, he broke it and said, 'This is my body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of me.'" - 1 Corinthians 11:24


Jesus is the memorial. He is the remembrance. He is the reminder. He gave us communion. He gave us the bread and the cup. He said, "Do this in remembrance of me." He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need to remember. You need to remember what Jesus did. You need to remember His sacrifice. The memorial tells a story of remembrance. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have a memorial. You have a remembrance.


Faith Builder
What do you need to remember about Jesus today? Write it down.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the memorial. Thank you for giving us communion. Thank you for the bread and the cup. Help me to remember your sacrifice. Help me to remember your love. Help me to remember you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 21: The Memorial

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"On the first day hold a sacred assembly, and another one on the seventh day. Do no work at all on these days, except to prepare food for everyone to eat; that is all you may do." - Exodus 12:16 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The first day and the seventh day were special. They were sacred assemblies. They were days of rest. They were days of worship. They were days of gathering. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"There remains, then, a Sabbath-rest for the people of God; for anyone who enters God's rest also rests from their works, just as God did from his." - Hebrews 4:9-10


Jesus is the first day. He is the seventh day. He is the rest. He is the worship. He is the gathering. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need rest. You need worship. You need gathering. The first and seventh day tells a story of rest. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have rest. You have worship. You have gathering.


Faith Builder
Do you need rest today? Write down one way you can rest in Jesus this week.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the first day. Thank you for being the seventh day. Thank you for being my rest. Thank you for being my worship. Help me to rest in you. Help me to worship you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 22: The First and Seventh Day

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"If any household is too small for a whole lamb, they must share one with their neighbors who live nearby, having regard for the number of people." - Exodus 12:4 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The lamb was for the household. It was for the family. It was for the neighbors. It was for the community. It was to be shared. It was to be eaten together. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching and to fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer." - Acts 2:42


Jesus is the lamb for the household. He is the lamb for the family. He is the lamb for the community. He is the lamb we share. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need community. You need fellowship. You need the family of God. The lamb for the household tells a story of community. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have a family. You have a community.


Faith Builder
Who is your community? Write down one person you can share a meal with this week.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the lamb for the household. Thank you for being the lamb for the family. Thank you for the community. Help me to share you with others. Help me to be part of your family. Amen.
pages.title: Day 23: The Lamb for the Household

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"Then they are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the lambs." - Exodus 12:7 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The blood was on the doorframe. It was on the sides. It was on the top. It was a sign. It was a protection. It was a covering. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God's grace." - Ephesians 1:7


Jesus is the blood on the doorframe. He is the sign. He is the protection. He is the covering. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need protection. You need covering. You need redemption. The blood on the doorframe tells a story of protection. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you are protected. You are covered. You are redeemed.


Faith Builder
Do you need protection today? Write down one thing you need Jesus to cover.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the blood on the doorframe. Thank you for being the sign. Thank you for being the protection. Thank you for being the covering. Thank you for redeeming me. Help me to trust in your blood. Amen.
pages.title: Day 24: The Blood on the Doorframe

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"It is the LORD's Passover." - Exodus 12:11 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Passover was the Lord's. It was His. It was His celebration. It was His memorial. It was His story. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed." - 1 Corinthians 5:7


Jesus is the Lord's Passover. He is the celebration. He is the memorial. He is the story. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need to celebrate. You need to remember. You need to tell the story. The Lord's Passover tells a story of celebration. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have something to celebrate. You have something to remember.


Faith Builder
What are you celebrating today? Write down one thing you are thankful for.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the Lord's Passover. Thank you for being the celebration. Thank you for being the memorial. Thank you for being the story. Help me to celebrate you. Help me to remember you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 25: The Lord's Passover

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"When the LORD goes through the land to strike down the Egyptians, he will see the blood on the top and sides of the doorframe and will pass over that doorway, and he will not permit the destroyer to enter your houses and strike you down." - Exodus 12:23 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The destroyer was coming. The destroyer was passing through. The destroyer was bringing judgment. But the blood was a sign. The blood was a protection. The blood stopped the destroyer. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"And having disarmed the powers and authorities, he made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross." - Colossians 2:15


Jesus is the one who stops the destroyer. He is the one who disarms the powers. He is the one who triumphs over the authorities. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You need protection from the destroyer. You need protection from the enemy. You need protection from the powers of darkness. The destroyer tells a story of protection. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you are protected. You are safe.


Faith Builder
Do you need protection from the enemy today? Write down one thing you need Jesus to protect you from.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for stopping the destroyer. Thank you for disarming the powers. Thank you for triumphing over the authorities. Thank you for protecting me. Help me to trust in your protection. Amen.
pages.title: Day 26: The Destroyer

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"On that same night I will pass through Egypt and strike down every firstborn of both people and animals, and I will bring judgment on all the gods of Egypt. I am the LORD." - Exodus 12:12 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The plague was judgment. It was judgment on Egypt. It was judgment on the gods of Egypt. It was judgment on the firstborn. But the blood was a sign. The blood was a protection. The blood stopped the judgment. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"Since we have now been justified by his blood, how much more shall we be saved from God's wrath through him!" - Romans 5:9


Jesus is the one who saves us from the wrath. He is the one who justifies us by His blood. He is the one who saves us from judgment. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You deserve judgment. You deserve wrath. You deserve the plague. But Jesus took it for you. The plague tells a story of substitution. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you are saved. You are justified. You are forgiven.


Faith Builder
Do you believe that Jesus saved you from judgment? Write down one thing you are thankful for about His sacrifice.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for saving me from the wrath. Thank you for justifying me by your blood. Thank you for taking the judgment for me. Thank you for the grace. Help me to trust in your sacrifice. Amen.
pages.title: Day 27: The Plague

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"This is a day you are to commemorate; for the generations to come you shall celebrate it as a festival to the LORD—a lasting ordinance." - Exodus 12:14 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Passover was a feast. It was a celebration. It was a festival. It was a time of joy. It was a time of gratitude. It was a time of remembrance. This was a symbol. It pointed to something greater.


The New Reality
"Then I heard what sounded like a great multitude, like the roar of rushing waters and like loud peals of thunder, shouting: 'Hallelujah! For our Lord God Almighty reigns. Let us rejoice and be glad and give him glory! For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready.'" - Revelation 19:6-7


Jesus is the feast. He is the celebration. He is the festival. He is the wedding of the Lamb. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony.


Why It Matters For You
You have something to celebrate. You have something to feast on. You have something to be joyful about. The feast tells a story of celebration. It tells a story of grace. Through Jesus, you have joy. You have celebration.


Faith Builder
What are you celebrating today? Write down one thing you are joyful about.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the feast. Thank you for being the celebration. Thank you for being the festival. Thank you for being the wedding of the Lamb. Help me to celebrate you. Help me to rejoice in you. Amen.

pages.title: Day 29: The Memorial

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Ceremony
"It is the LORD's Passover." - Exodus 12:11 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Passover was a shadow. It was a symbol. It was a ceremony. It was pointing to something greater. It was pointing to someone greater. It was pointing to Jesus.


The New Reality
"For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed. Therefore let us keep the Festival..." - 1 Corinthians 5:7-8


Jesus is the real meaning. He is the Passover lamb. He is the sacrifice. He is the fulfillment of the ceremony. He is the real meaning of the Passover.


Why It Matters For You
You have the real meaning. You have Jesus. You do not need to keep looking at the ceremony. You can live in the reality. You can live in the substance. You can live in Christ. You have the real meaning of the Passover.


Faith Builder
What is one thing you have learned about the real meaning of the Passover over the last 30 days? Write it down.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the real meaning of the Passover. Thank you for being the Passover lamb. Thank you for being the sacrifice. Thank you for being the fulfillment of the ceremony. Help me to live in the reality. Help me to live in you. Amen.



END MATTER


The 30-Day Passover Challenge
You have journeyed through 30 details of the Passover. Now what? I challenge you to read the book of Hebrews. It is 13 chapters. It is the perfect follow-up to this book. It will show you how Jesus is greater than the angels, greater than Moses, greater than the priests, and greater than the sacrifices. As you read, look for the shadows. Look for the substance. Look for Jesus.


A Note on Faith
The ceremonies are evidence. They are evidence of a divine plan. But evidence does not save you. The ceremonies point to a person. The ceremonies point to Jesus. You can understand the ceremonies and still miss the substance. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The ceremonies are on the table. The door is open. It is your choice.


About the Author
Christine A. writes for the spiritually curious. He is passionate about showing people the hidden wisdom of the Bible. He lives with his family and enjoys good coffee and long conversations with skeptics. He believes that honest questions deserve honest answers.
